sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Column headers that contain an emoji such as 🔗, 🖼 or 📋 keep it intact in the 👁️ column-visibility menus and wherever the script looks a column up by its name. The code that removes the script's own header decorations (⇅ ▲ ▼ 📊 …) also removed half of every emoji that shares a building block with 📊, which left a broken character behind, e.g. "\uDD17 Links" instead of "🔗 Links". MusicBrainz's own headers carry no emoji, so this only showed on columns that another userscript adds or decorates. The saved show/hide choice for such a column was stored under the broken name, so it is forgotten once, after which it is saved correctly.
The column name in a column-filter error message no longer keeps the sort-priority superscripts ¹ ² ³.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: All 57 hits of ESLint's no-misleading-character-class rule are fixed, 32 in the userscript and 25 in the test harness, and the lint baseline is lowered to match. A new source-level check (tests/fixtures/regex-unicode-flag-guard.spec.js) runs in npm test and keeps the rule at zero in the userscript and the library while ESLint itself stays report-only.
